FAQ

Where can I sell sports cards in Whitby?
We Got Gamez and Maximum Cards & Collectibles buy sports card collections in Whitby, Ontario, according to Sports Cards Near Me. This page lists them ranked by rating. Whitby shop directory
How much are my cards worth?
There's no single number for a whole collection — value depends on the player, the card's rarity, and its condition, and it can vary a lot even within one binder. Our guide walks through how to sort a collection and tell what's actually worth a closer look before you sell. guide to selling a collection
Is it better to sell to a shop or online?
A local shop is the fastest option and pays on the spot, but the price reflects the fact that the shop still has to resell what it buys from you. Selling it yourself online usually nets more, at the cost of photographing, listing, and shipping every card yourself. Our guide compares the full range of options. guide to selling a collection
